title.en: AN ACT ANNEXING THE BARRIO OF SAN GASPAR, OF THE MUNICIPALITY OF SANTA LUCIA, TO THE MUNICIPALITY OF CANDON, BOTH IN THE PROVINCE OF ILOCOS SUR.
title.orig: AN ACT ANNEXING THE BARRIO OF SAN GASPAR, OF THE MUNICIPALITY OF SANTA LUCIA, TO THE MUNICIPALITY OF CANDON, BOTH IN THE PROVINCE OF ILOCOS SUR.

source.name: The LawPhil Project — Arellano Law Foundation

completenessNote: 全文，共 3 条；逐字取自 LawPhil PDF 文本化成果（第三方 OCR，非机翻），原始文件 ACT_01255_1904_html.txt

text.en:
The barrio of San Gaspar, now a part of the municipality of Santa Lucia, Province of Ilocos Sur, is
hereby annexed to and consolidated with the municipality of Candon, in the same province.

The public good requiring the speedy enactment of this bill, the passage of the same is hereby
expedited in accordance with section two of "An Act prescribing the order of procedure by the Commission
in the enactment; of laws," passed September twenty -sixth nineteen hundred.

This Act shall take effect on its passage.
Enacted, October 26, 1904.
